disposition.target: Architecture v5 (slides 20 and 28) and RWB-P7 rwb-decision ledger
disposition.change: Adopt producer-side write inside the generation transaction with atomic idempotent ledger append; keep MSG-P7-003 as refusal; decide strict mode at architecture review, adding ledger acknowledgement as its own change if needed.
disposition.note: Design choice belongs to the architecture and P7 documents. Story DP-03 row already reads the record without writing a ledger entry.

disposition.change: Take generation operation and shapes from RWB-P5-E2026-CON; add two nullable treatment columns (document reference, pinned template version) and index; event name and code stay as story design until catalogue owner confirms.

disposition.target: TSD P6 rwb_comms schema (V-baseline) and P6 API specification
disposition.change: Add a table in rwb_comms for the idempotency key and request lock via the V-baseline migration; record the rwb-document create operation from RWB-P5-E2026-CON in the P6 API specification.
disposition.note: New rwb_comms table and P6 operation are other-document changes. No rwb_comms table name is given in the sources.

disposition.target: FSD S2 A2.18, A2.15, A2.8 and TSD S2 T3.1
